prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1235; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with a complaint of right shoulder pain, reduced range of motion, and difficulty with overhead reaching and lifting. Initial examination revealed tenderness over the anterior shoulder, limited active abduction and flexion, and pain with resisted internal rotation. Imaging was reviewed and no acute fracture or dislocation was identified. Clinical findings were most consistent with a rotator cuff strain with associated soft tissue inflammation.

Care consisted of 12 outpatient visits over the course of the treatment period. The plan included manual therapy, progressive therapeutic exercise focused on scapular stabilization and rotator cuff strengthening, cryotherapy, and a home exercise program. Anti-inflammatory medication was prescribed for pain control during the early phase of care.

By the final visit, the patient demonstrated improved range of motion, increased strength, and a substantial reduction in pain with daily activities. Residual mild discomfort with heavy overhead lifting persisted. The patient was discharged to an independent home exercise program with instructions to return if symptoms worsen or fail to resolve.
